changelog: 0-0-2 rebuilt as a landscape mobile sports game.
Swipe controls and automatic positioning have been removed.
Added a left virtual joystick for full manual court movement and shot aiming.
Added dedicated Drive, Dink, Slice and Lob buttons on the right side.
Shot quality now depends on player position, distance to the ball and movement at contact.
0-0-2 remains launched from Home and is not added to bottom navigation.
